walk_graph.text: Find employee IDs of the authors and key reviewers of the Technical Specifications Document for the SupportForce product?

queries.cypher: MATCH (d:Document) RETURN d.id, d.source_id, d.type, d.release_scope
MATCH (p:Person)-[au:AUTHORED]->(d:Document) WHERE d.id IN $docs AND ($role IS NULL OR p.role = $role) RETURN p.eid, p.name, p.role, d.id, au.src

MATCH (p:Person)-[s:SUGGESTED]->(d:Document) WHERE d.id IN $docs AND s.kind IN ['suggestion', 'review_question'] AND ($role IS NULL OR p.role = $role) RETURN p.eid, p.name, p.role, d.id, s.kind, s.section, s.text, s.ambiguous, s.src

lines: AND ($components IS NULL OR b.component IN $components)
AND ($companies IS NULL OR any(x IN b.companies WHERE x IN $companies))
MATCH (b)-[hs:HAS_EVENT]->(rs:BugEvent) WHERE rs.type = 'RESOLVED' AND pr.link IN rs.fix_pr_links
MATCH (b)-[:HAS_EVENT]->(ro:BugEvent) WHERE ro.type = 'REOPENED' AND ro.ts > rs.ts
RETURN p.eid, p.name, p.role, b.id, pr.link, op.src, fx.src + hs.src, [rs.id]
